summary: All four named gaps are genuinely closed and I re-derived the executor's mutation claims independently; nothing the repo publishes moved. Two Majors, both advisory: tools/package-chart.sh repacks every chart, so the new immutability check condemns the repo's own publish command (demonstrated red on a no-op repack with misleading remediation text, and permanently red in history once a second chart is published), and both immutability checks silently vacate when git exits non-zero while the gate still prints its success line (demonstrated: the P2 reviewer's exact tamper sequence passes green with no .git). One Minor: one refute assertion cannot be tripped by a mutation of the branch it guards, so the done-record's blanket bite claim overstates.
